title: Thor: Tales of Asgard
edition: 2011 Lionsgate animated DVD feature directed by Sam Liu, 77 minutes
synopsis: Thor secretly joins a voyage with Loki to find Surtur’s sword. Two sentries die by Thor’s hand, and a truce between kingdoms breaks down.
verdictRationale: Thor earns his father’s respect when he gives up the sword and offers to answer for the dead sentries. The king who lost them shows mercy. Even Loki, who saved his family, questions the vengeance behind his act. These scenes give families grounds to admire peacemaking and honest self-examination.
ageRationale: Repeated armed battles, the deaths of two sentries and a son’s fear for his wounded father may weigh on younger viewers. The tavern humor includes drinking and sexual innuendo.
reflection: Thor cannot restore the sentries’ lives. He can tell their king the truth and surrender the prize that started the fighting. In confession, naming whom we have hurt can help us see what repair is still possible.

title: The Invincible Iron Man
edition: 2007 Lions Gate US animated DVD, approximately 83 minutes, Marc Worden as Tony Stark
synopsis: Tony Stark raises the ruins of an ancient city and learns that the Mandarin may return through Li Mei. Her family has taught her that becoming his vessel is her purpose.
verdictRationale: Tony stays beside Li Mei after she admits deceiving him. He calls her by name when the Mandarin claims her, and her choice helps save them both. The story gives that loyalty real weight, while its spectacle dwells on possession and the exposure of a woman whose body is under another’s control.
ageRationale: The animated feature combines sustained threats of killing with a possession sequence involving partial nudity. The loss of control over Li Mei’s body may be more disturbing than the armored battles.
reflection: Li Mei’s father speaks as though her life belongs to an ancestor. Tony addresses her as someone who can still answer. A family can consider how speaking a person’s name, listening and staying nearby can affirm dignity when that person feels powerless.
